text:
maria.cs: FYI Prism go-live scheduled 08:30 PT tomorrow. Need final quota confirmation, autoscale policy signoff, and a concise smoke/soak checklist. Who can own the verification window?

leo.eng: I can run the verification and own autoscale validation. What are the target SLOs?

maria.cs: Customer SLOs: p95 < 220ms, errors < 0.4%. They requested a 20% burst headroom for first 25m and explicit rollback steps.

jasmin.ops: Quota as provisioned: us-west-2a=45, us-west-2b=35, us-west-2c=20. Commit id prism-2026-03-15. Finance pre-approved +1 replica for up to 30 minutes if needed.

owen.sre: Recommend starting with autoscale policy "slow-warm" for first 15m (scale_step=1/90s) to avoid kernel JIT spikes. We saw a cold-KV window in a recent customer run.

leo.eng: Plan two quick tests:
- steady: 65% expected QPS for 12m (validate p95 steady)
- ramp: 0->100% in 4m, hold 8m (validate burst handling + fallback)
Runner: k6 distributed. Example: `k6 run --vus 180 --duration 12m prism_steady.js --out json=steady.json`

maria.cs: Please record KV hit-rate, kernel/JIT logs, and heap profiles. Upload artifacts to s3 and post link here.

artifacts-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-ops/prism/bringup/1795000000/steady.json

leo.eng: Steady run results: p95=205ms, errors=0.25%, KV hit-rate=81%, avg CPU 70%. Artifact: https://s3.aws/redwood/prism/1795000000/steady-report.zip

leo.eng: Ramp run (slow-warm policy) results: brief cold-window ~60s with p95 spike to 390ms, then settled at 210ms. No OOMs. Artifact: https://s3.aws/redwood/prism/1795000000/ramp-slowwarm.zip

leo.eng: Ramp run (immediate-burst policy) results: no prolonged cold window but CPU spiked to 92% and we saw transient GC pauses; p95 peaked 330ms. Artifact: https://s3.aws/redwood/prism/1795000000/ramp-burst.zip

ownen.sre: Notes: immediate-burst avoided KV warm but increased GC risk. If we stick with slow-warm we should enable prefix-KV priming for the first 20m to reduce the initial spike.

jasmin.ops: I can toggle a one-time prefix-priming flag and pre-populate top prefixes. Also have a temporary slot for +1 replica ready (portal id: quota-PR-900).

maria.cs: Trade-off discussion: priming reduces spike without extra capacity; +1 replica fixes spikes but costs more. Customer prefers minimal surprises and asked for cost transparency.

leo.eng: Recommendation: enable prefix priming + slow-warm autoscale for first 20m. Add auto-fallback to warm-replica if p95>450ms for more than 60s. I'll capture metrics and upload artifacts.

ownen.sre: I'll lower OOM alert thresholds and watch 08:15-09:15 PT. Rollback steps: revert priming flag, spin warm replica, route 10% traffic to fallback model. Added to runbook.

jasmin.ops: Priming flag enabled in prod staging and prefixes pre-populated. Runbook updated: https://confluence.redwood/ops/prism-bringup

leo.eng: Final verification scheduled 07:50 PT. artifacts-bot: please upload final run bundle after verify.

artifacts-bot: Final upload: s3://redwood-ops/prism/bringup/1795000000/final-bundle.tar.gz

maria.cs: Thanks team. I'll update the AE and customer with the plan + post-cutover check-in at 10:00 PT. Closing loop after the verification run.
